name: M7.OrbitResidual.orbit_disjoint
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ c d : M7.Action.Recipe N, Disjoint (M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c) (M7.ActualOrbit.orbit d) ↔ d ∉ M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c
context:
theorem M7.OrbitResidual.orbit_action : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (c : M7.Action.Recipe N) (g : M7.Action.Record N), M7.ActualOrbit.orbit (M7.Action.act g c) = M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c := by
  intro N inst c g
  classical
  unfold M7.ActualOrbit.orbit
  ext y
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    refine ⟨M7.Action.compose h g, ?_⟩
    rw [M7.Action.act_compose]
    exact hh
  · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
    refine ⟨M7.Action.compose h (M7.Action.inverse g), ?_⟩
    rw [M7.Action.act_compose, M7.Action.act_inverse]
    exact hh
guidance:
Prove the original finite disjoint-orbit subtraction invariant for the actual M7 Action.Record action. This module is a semantic proof bridge: final arithmetic total and factorized numerator will be substituted by already planned exact count identities, and Separated will be discharged by the actual canonical form. Do not assume a complete transversal. orbit is univ.image(act g c); use accepted act_identity/act_compose/act_inverse and concrete group instances. orbit_action via compose and inverse; orbit_disjoint via common point then inverse action. covered is actual biUnion. sum_intersections: filter/biUnion commutation plus Finset.card_biUnion for pairwise disjoint orbit filters, or finite induction on bases. Integer subtraction_card follows card_sdiff/inter and cast of finite sums, ensuring no truncated-natural subtraction masks negativity. Partition requires disjoint children. Fresh canonical insertion here takes any actual realizing action g, so the final caller supplies the already proved realizer. insert_strict removes at least the witnessed y and proves strict finite cardinal decrease. No raw support-pair generator is introduced. Return tactic lines only.
import M7ActualOrbitAccepted

namespace M7.OrbitResidual
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable def covered {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N) := by
  classical
  exact bases.biUnion M7.ActualOrbit.orbit
noncomputable def remaining {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (C bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N) := by
  classical
  exact C \ covered bases
def Separated {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) : Prop :=
  ∀ c ∈ bases, ∀ d ∈ bases, c ≠ d → Disjoint (M7.ActualOrbit.orbit c) (M7.ActualOrbit.orbit d)
noncomputable def subtraction {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (C bases : Finset (M7.Action.Recipe N)) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact (C.card : ℤ) - ∑ c ∈ bases, (M7.ActualOrbit.distinctCount c (fun y => y ∈ C) : ℤ)
end M7.OrbitResidual
